scope: Foreground Flutter Android microphone capture and RNNoise frame processing in a single-participant owned LiveKit room. No app background or screen lock was exercised.

environment.server: Owned disposable Go/PostgreSQL/LiveKit QA stack; no production service
environment.microphone_permission: Granted to the emulator app by the isolated QA runner

scenario.processed_microphone_frames: Greater than zero; count increased during a three-second follow-up interval

visual_review.observation: At source resolution, the audio settings show RNNoise active and the voice dock shows a connected room with one participant. No visual defect was observed in this capture.

test_assertions: processed frame count greater than zero and increasing

limitations: The app stayed foreground; microphone FGS continuity during Home or screen lock was not measured.
The room contained one participant. No remote receiver RTP counters, decoded samples, or audible playback were measured.
This does not establish 60-minute background continuity, physical Android behavior, iOS acceptance, network switching, or release behavior.
The generic runner report marks media and Android Back as NOT_RUN; this record scopes the separate frame-processing assertions from the integration target only.
Issue #785 remains open and this result does not close its release gate.
